name: bloodlink-ai
description: BloodLink AI — the intelligence layer for the blood supply network

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && node scripts/setup-ai.mjs
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && node scripts/run-ai.mjs test
